Contest a Citation

You may contest a parking citation within 21 calendar days of the citation issue date.

Contests sent by mail must be received by the SFMTA by the deadline.

Contest by mail

SFMTA Customer Service Center
ATTN: Citation Review
11 South Van Ness Avenue
San Francisco, CA 94103

Include your citation number and a copy of any evidence you want reviewed.

A signed declaration is not required for a first-level review.

Contact SFMTA · Accessibility · 21 days or 30 days, see terms
